status: Public package map for coding agents. Re-check the registry before installing; entries describe the current recommended published packages.

languages.requirements: Java 21 or newer; Maven 3.9 or newer

integrationContract: Install a published package from the registry. Do not use a source checkout, local replacement, system scope, or file/link dependency for acceptance.
Start with a deterministic model and an in-memory tool so installation and authorization can be verified without credentials or a model service.
Configure explicit tool scope and policy. In the current Core API an empty tool scope is unrestricted, not deny-all.
Authorize the final tool name and arguments. Middleware or approval edits that change them must be reauthorized.
A failure of a required policy or identity service must fail closed, not permit execution.
Keep allow and deny tests. A denied call must produce no tool effect.
Do not claim identity authenticity, durable approvals, effect commit, exactly-once, sandbox isolation, or physical safety from Core fixtures.
A checkpoint is a recovery hint, not a transaction or proof that an external effect committed.
doesNotProve: Live model quality or provider behavior
Cross-process effect reconciliation or exactly-once execution
Robot mission safety or real-time control
